Based on my analysis of the codebase, here are the answers:

**1. Where is it guaranteed that no two articles share the same slug?**
`prisma/schema.prisma :: Article.slug` (line 41) — @unique constraint ensures database-level uniqueness

**2. Where is it computed whether the requesting (current) user follows an article's author?**
`src/routes/articles.ts :: buildArticleResponse` (lines 60-71) — queries Follow table for followerId-followingId match

**3. Where is the authentication token verified on incoming requests?**
`src/utils/jwt.ts :: verifyToken` (line 10) — uses jwt.verify to validate token signature
